scripts/ci

Fixed-vocabulary internal GitLab operations for exact artifact retrieval, secret-isolated live review, language-selective publication planning, and the root-installed devbox publisher.

Operator flow

  1. Select evidence: use an exact branch, full commit SHA, and successful gate job. Live review also selects provider-matched launchables; publication selects languages and immutable or stable delivery.
  2. Acquire without candidate execution: the protected child job verifies GitLab metadata and emits only the bounded archive and request record.
  3. Exercise or publish: a separate secret-free job builds the pinned browser runtime without opening candidate content. Candidate browsers run without protected variables. Live probes receive only environment-scoped file secrets. CDN preparation has no AWS authority; the root-installed devbox publisher accepts only its hash plan.

Open the exact glab branch/language commands and runner provisioning steps.

These operations are internal GitLab capabilities. Public GitHub receives the source and ordinary validation, but no trigger, secret, protected environment, devbox runner, or AWS authority.
